session:s-opening: The Opening Ceremony & Welcome runs Wednesday, May 27, 09:00 to 09:30 at Hudson Hall. It is a kickoff for the summit covering what to expect across three days and how to make the most of the venue. It features Speaker 19 in the Startups track.
session:s-ai-future-work: "AI and the Future of Work" is scheduled Wednesday, May 27, 09:45 to 10:30 at Chelsea Pavilion, in the AI track, featuring Speaker 53. It covers how AI assistants are reshaping every role and where founders should place their bets over the next three years.
session:s-deep-tech: "Building Deep Tech in New York" is on Wednesday, May 27, 10:00 to 10:20 at Tribeca Theater, in the AI track, featuring Speaker 6. It covers what it takes to run a research-heavy startup in the city, from hiring to compute budgets.
session:s-lab-to-product: "From Lab to Product: The Company 2 Story" is scheduled Wednesday, May 27, 11:00 to 11:45 at the Hudson Hall, in the AI track. It is a conversation on turning bleeding-edge research into a product customers actually pay for, featuring Speaker 6 and Speaker 19.
session:s-voice-interface: "Voice Is the Next Interface" runs Wednesday, May 27, 11:30 to 12:00 at Chelsea Pavilion. It explores how synthetic voice is moving from a novelty to the default way we talk to the software around us. It features Speaker 1 in the AI track.
session:s-fintech-after-boom: Fintech After the Boom is a session on Wednesday, May 27, from 13:00 to 13:30 at Tribeca Theater. It covers what the next wave of financial infrastructure looks like now that cheap capital is gone. It features Speaker 3 and Speaker 4 in the Fintech track.
session:s-scaling-borders: Scaling Across Borders is in the Fintech track and features Speaker 4. It runs Wednesday, May 27, 14:00 to 14:45 at the Hudson Hall. Its topic is lessons from building a payroll platform that works in every country, not just the easy ones.
session:s-mobility-city-scale: Mobility at City Scale is a fireside chat on running a transport network across dozens of cities at once. It features Speaker 5 in the Startups track. It takes place Wednesday, May 27, 15:30 to 16:15, at Chelsea Pavilion.
session:s-creative-ai-renaissance: The Creative AI Renaissance is a session on Thursday, May 28, 09:30 to 10:00 at the Hudson Hall. It covers why generative video is opening a new market for creators and what that means for every studio. It features Speaker 7 in the AI track.
session:s-what-vcs-want: "What VCs Want in 2026" is scheduled Thursday, May 28, 10:15 to 11:00, at Chelsea Pavilion, in the Startups track. It features two investors, Speaker 3 and Speaker 10, discussing the metrics, narratives and teams that are getting funded this year.
session:s-hiring-first-ten: "Hiring Your First Ten" is a session on Thursday, May 28, 11:00 to 11:25 at Tribeca Theater, in the Startups track, featuring Speaker 4. It covers how to hire the small team that defines whether your company compounds or stalls.
session:s-runway-new-studio: Company 6 and the New Studio is scheduled Thursday, May 28, 11:45 to 12:30 at the Hudson Hall. It offers a hands-on look at how AI tools fit into a modern film and video production pipeline. It features Speaker 7 in the AI track.
session:s-city-to-world: "From New York to the World" runs Thursday, May 28, 13:00 to 13:45 at Chelsea Pavilion. It covers how founders from smaller markets build companies with global reach from day one. It features Speaker 5 and Speaker 19 in the Culture track.
session:s-openai-for-startups: Company 7 for Startups is on Thursday, May 28, 14:30 to 15:00 at Tribeca Theater. It is a working session on shipping with frontier models, from fine-tuning to production guardrails. It features Speaker 10 in the AI track.
session:s-startup-moment: The New York Startup Moment is a panel on why New York keeps attracting founders and capital. It runs Thursday, May 28, 15:30 to 16:15 at the Hudson Hall, in the Culture track. It features Speaker 5 and Speaker 19.
session:s-microsoft-playbook: Sponsor 7's Startup Playbook is scheduled Thursday, May 28, 16:30 to 17:00 at Chelsea Pavilion. It covers how one of the largest cloud platforms thinks about partnering with early-stage companies. It features Speaker 53 in the Startups track.
session:s-deep-tech-frontiers: Deep Tech Frontiers is on Friday, May 29, 09:30 to 10:15, at Hudson Hall. It features two technical founders, Speaker 6 and Speaker 7, in the AI track, discussing the research problems that will define the next decade.
session:s-attention-economy: The Attention Economy is in the Culture track, featuring Speaker 1. It runs Friday, May 29, 10:30 to 11:00 at Chelsea Pavilion. Its description: why voice and video are winning attention, and what that means for media businesses.
session:s-media-age-ai: Media in the Age of AI is a panel on how newsrooms and studios adapt when anyone can generate text and video. It runs Friday, May 29, 11:00 to 11:40 at Tribeca Theater, in the Culture track, and features Speaker 10 and Speaker 19.
session:s-closing-series-a: Closing the Series A is Friday, May 29, 12:00 to 12:45, at Hudson Hall. It is a practical workshop on building the data room and story that gets a term sheet signed. It features Speaker 3 in the Fintech track.
session:s-bolt-road-unicorn: Company 5's Road to a Unicorn is a fireside chat on Friday, May 29, 13:30 to 14:15 at Chelsea Pavilion. It covers the early decisions that compounded into one of the region's fastest scale-ups. It features Speaker 5 in the Startups track.
session:s-ai-companions-agents: AI Companions and Agents is scheduled Friday, May 29, 14:30 to 15:00 at Tribeca Theater. It is a workshop on building useful autonomous agents that people actually trust. It features Speaker 53 in the AI track.
session:s-next-ten-years: The Next Ten Years is a closing panel on the technologies and markets worth watching over the coming decade. It runs Friday, May 29, 15:30 to 16:15 at Hudson Hall, in the Culture track. It features Speaker 3, Speaker 19, and Speaker 53.
session:s-founders-lightning: Founders' Lightning Round is Friday, May 29, 16:30 to 17:15 at Chelsea Pavilion. It features fast talks from founders on the one lesson they wish they had learned earlier. It features Speaker 1 and Speaker 4 in the Startups track.
session:side-day-one: Side Events Wednesday runs Wednesday, May 27, 09:00 to 23:00, at Side Events. It includes partner-hosted dinners, demos and meetups around the city; the full list is available via the external link (https://lu.ma/eventor-day-one). It is in the Startups track.
session:side-day-two: Side Events Thursday runs Thursday, May 28, 09:00 to 23:00 at Side Events. It includes partner-hosted dinners, demos and meetups around the city; the external link has the full list. It is in the Startups track.
session:side-day-three: Side Events Friday runs Friday, May 29, 09:00 to 23:00 at Side Events. It includes partner-hosted dinners, demos, and meetups around the city; the full list is available via the external link. It is featured in the Startups track.
sideEvent:se-founders-breakfast: Founders Breakfast at the Park is hosted by Sponsor 32 at Bryant Park Kiosk, Midtown, on Wednesday, May 27, 08:30 to 10:00. It features coffee, pastries and honest talk about the week ahead for early-stage founders.
sideEvent:se-ai-art-walk: AI Art Gallery Walk is on Wednesday, May 27, 18:00 to 20:30 at Organizer 1 Hall. It is a guided walk through a show of works made with generative tools and human hands. It is hosted by Organizer 1 at Organizer 1 Hall, Chelsea.
sideEvent:se-fintech-drinks: Fintech Founders Drinks is on Wednesday, May 27, from 19:30 to 23:00 at Flatiron Rooftop Bar, Flatiron. It is an evening for fintech founders and investors to trade notes away from the stages. It is hosted by Sponsor 10.
sideEvent:se-pitch-clinic: Pitch Deck Clinic is on Wednesday, May 27, 14:00 to 16:00 at SoHo Studio, SoHo. It is hosted by Sponsor 5. Attendees bring their deck and get ten focused minutes with an investor who reads a hundred a month.
sideEvent:se-media-breakfast: The Media and Stories Breakfast is on Thursday, May 28, 09:00 to 10:30, at Greenwich Courtyard Cafe. It is hosted by Organizer 2 at Greenwich Courtyard Cafe, West Village. Journalists and founders meet over breakfast to find the stories behind the summit.
sideEvent:se-robotics-demo: The Robotics Showcase is Thursday, May 28, 10:00 to 12:00 at Innovation Dock, DUMBO, hosted by Startup 2. It features live demos of warehouse robots that work safely next to people, plus a build corner.
sideEvent:se-ai-workshop: Prompt Engineering Workshop is Thursday, May 28, 14:00 to 15:30 at The High Line Room. It is a hands-on session on structuring prompts and guardrails for production systems, hosted by Sponsor 6 at The High Line Room, Meatpacking.
sideEvent:se-investor-roundtables: Investor Roundtables take place Thursday, May 28, 14:15 to 16:00 at Capital Club, Murray Hill, hosted by Sponsor 36. They feature small tables with one investor each, giving twenty minutes to make your case in person.
sideEvent:se-creative-coding: Creative Coding Jam takes place Thursday, May 28, 16:30 to 18:30 at Tribeca Annex Studio, Tribeca. It is hosted by Startup 6. Participants build a tiny generative piece in an afternoon, with mentors from New York studios.
sideEvent:se-night-market: Startup Night Market takes place Thursday, May 28, from 20:00 to 23:30 at Williamsburg Courtyard. It features food stalls, live sets, and demo tables from startups around the neighborhood. It is hosted by Eventor Summit at Williamsburg Courtyard, Williamsburg.
sideEvent:se-climate-talk: Climate Tech Talk is on Friday, May 29, 09:30 to 10:30 at Brooklyn Stage. It is a short talk on home energy storage and where the grid is heading next, hosted by Organizer 3 at Brooklyn Stage, Brooklyn Heights.
sideEvent:se-women-in-tech: The Women in Tech Meetup is on Friday, May 29, from 11:00 to 12:30 at Union Square Hall, Union Square. It is hosted by Organizer 4. It is described as a relaxed meetup for women across the summit to swap stories and introductions.
sideEvent:se-solo-founder-talk: Solo Founder Stories takes place Friday, May 29, 15:00 to 16:00 at Library Lounge, Kips Bay, hosted by Sponsor 11. It features three solo founders discussing building without a co-founder and keeping momentum.
sideEvent:se-closing-party: The Closing Night Party is Friday, May 29, 20:30 to 23:59 at Skyline Terrace, Long Island City. Hosted by Sponsor 1, it closes the summit with drinks, music and a view over the city.
sponsor:sponsor-skyline: Sponsor 1 is a major U.S. airline and flies attendees to the summit from across the country.
sponsor:sponsor-nbg: Sponsor 2 is one of the city’s oldest banks. It backs founders with capital and advice.
sponsor:sponsor-kaizen: Sponsor 3 is a gaming and technology company behind some of the region’s most played platforms.
sponsor:sponsor-dei: Sponsor 4 is a regional power utility. It is investing in energy and climate startups.
sponsor:sponsor-deep-capital: Sponsor 5 is a venture firm that backs technical founders across North America and Europe.
sponsor:sponsor-helios-cloud: Sponsor 6 is a cloud infrastructure provider powering the summit app and demos.
pitch:reel-001: Startup 1 is building a platform that helps small farmers sell directly to restaurants, with fair prices and next-day delivery. Attendee 1 is Founder & CEO.
pitch:reel-002: Startup 2 designs warehouse robots that work safely alongside people. These robots slow down and steer around people to operate safely next to them. Attendee 3 is Co-Founder at Startup 2.
pitch:reel-melody-minds: Startup 3 is a music-learning app that listens to how you practice and adapts every lesson. It is described as building a music-learning app that adapts to how each student practices. Attendee 9 is Founder at Startup 3.
pitch:reel-003: Startup 4 builds an electric boat-rental network for harbor tourism. Its rentals are described as quiet, clean, and booked from your phone. Attendee 11 is CEO at Startup 4.
pitch:reel-harbor-health: Startup 5 builds remote-monitoring tools for chronic-care clinics, letting them spot problems before visits. Its founder is Attendee 13.
pitch:reel-pixel-forge: Startup 6 is a game engine that lets small teams build stylized 3D worlds without a big studio. Attendee 15 is Co-Founder at Startup 6.
